ideas.topic: The Hidden Message in Tutankhamun's Dagger
ideas.hook: This dagger didn't come from Earth; it fell from the sky.
ideas.why: It leverages the mystery of extraterrestrial artifacts while grounding it in the proven scientific fact that the blade was forged from meteoric iron.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptians Really Wore Makeup
ideas.hook: It wasn't just for beauty; the eyeliner they wore might have actually saved their lives.
ideas.why: This addresses a common daily life question while highlighting the surprising, practical medical benefits of lead-based kohl in an ancient environment.

ideas.topic: The Pharaoh Who Vanished from History
ideas.hook: Ancient records intentionally erased her name, but they couldn't destroy her monuments.
ideas.why: The narrative of 'erasure' and 'discovery' taps into the high-performing 'secret history' pattern found in viral archaeology content.
